---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature, primitive, adapter, or tool plugin
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the use case rather than jumping straight to a solution.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like Circuitry to do, ideally with a sketch of how it would look in YAML or in the API:

```yaml
# example shape
- type: <new-effect>
  name: example
  ...
```

## Alternatives considered

What workarounds you tried, and why they fall short.

## Additional context

Related issues, prior-art links, examples from other frameworks, performance considerations, etc.

## Are you willing to contribute this?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to open a PR
- [ ] I can help test or review
- [ ] I'm just suggesting the idea
